tasks.title: Add --check drift mode to the generator
tasks.description: Add a --check flag: regenerate in memory, diff against the committed .woodpecker.yml in the target repo, exit 1 with a clear diff-based message if they differ. This is the mechanism app repos use in their own generated pipeline to keep .woodpecker.yml from silently drifting from .fawkespipe.yml.
acceptance_criteria: generate_woodpecker_yml.py --check exits 0 when committed file matches fresh generation
generate_woodpecker_yml.py --check exits 1 with a diff when they differ
Unit test covers both branches
